items.text: Bears TE Cole Kmet believed to have suffered a serious, likely season-ending knee injury after being carted off non-contact in TNF vs Patriots; undergoing further tests with no finality yet. Coach Ben Johnson said it did not look very good.
items.why: Carted off, knee buckle before/after contact, coach comments, sources via Rapoport.
items.implication: Loveland becomes clearer TE1 with higher route/target ceiling; more 3WR sets possible boosting Burden; Roush for blocking only.
items.opportunity: Increased snaps/routes/targets for Colston Loveland and Luther Burden in Bears passing game.

items.text: Rams WR Puka Nacua suffered what is believed to be a minor calf injury after leaving Thursday practice early; tests confirm more minor than significant but availability for Sunday vs Raiders remains up in the air/GTD.
items.why: Left practice, limited tag, Rapoport tests update; Schefter reported exit.
items.implication: Monitor Friday practice/final report; if out, targets concentrate to TEs/RBs/backups like Mumpfield with Adams already out long-term.
items.opportunity: If inactive, elevated TE target share (prior 37% when Puka out) and backup WR snaps.

items.text: TreVeyon Henderson has played just 21% of snaps over the last three weeks. Not like this for the rookie.
items.why: Snap share data last 3 weeks shows limited role despite prior hype.
items.implication: Bench/flex risk or drop candidate in shallower leagues; handcuff/monitor for role change only.
items.opportunity: Low; limited carries/routes until snap share expands.

items.text: Luther Burden has run only 68.8% of routes this season but elite 2.56 YPRR. Kmet injury may reduce 2- and 3-TE sets, giving Burden even more juice/routes.
items.why: Route rate + YPRR data; Kmet absence shifts personnel toward more WR sets.
items.implication: Burden ROS/target upside rises as primary beneficiary alongside Loveland; strong buy/hold.
items.opportunity: Higher route share, targets, YPRR realization in Bears offense post-Kmet.

items.text: Multiple teams open to potential trade for Colts RB Jonathan Taylor; unclear if Colts ready to unload before deadline.
items.implication: Hold for now; destination could boost or maintain value. Colts decision pending.
items.opportunity: If traded to better offense, RB1 lock; monitor deadline.

items.text: Saquon Barkley is back for Week 7. Berry views fantasy value as he returns to Eagles lineup (in-line expectations).
items.why: Confirmed return; Berry analysis on expected role/value.
items.implication: RB1 start immediately; volume expected in PHI offense.

items.text: Berry loves A.J. Brown vs CHI (high in Love/Hate and 10 Facts buy): 33% target share, 97% routes in Week 6 despite 3 catches/3 drops/27 yards on 10 targets. Buying the usage.
items.why: Elite target/route share persists; volume buy-low after inefficient game; good matchup theme vs Bears.
items.implication: Strong WR1/2 start; buy in trades.
items.opportunity: High target share and routes regardless of recent efficiency.

items.text: Berry hates Josh Jacobs @ DET (RB18 Love/Hate) due to workload questions after layoff. Levitan notes Jacobs allowed in facility meetings/lifting/medical but non-football; backups Lloyd/Johnson very poor EPA/rush.
items.why: Layoff/workload uncertainty (Berry); facility access but poor backup EPA (Levitan).
items.implication: Cautious start; monitor activation. Backups not trustworthy if limited.
items.opportunity: If full go, volume; else limited upside for handcuffs.
items.conflict: Levitan more neutral/positive on long-term via facility access vs Berry hate.

items.text: With Terrance Ferguson IR recovery delayed (not ready next week), Rams only answer is 25 Puka Nacua targets per game post-Adams injury.
items.why: Ferguson delay removes main beneficiary; target vacuum to Puka.
items.implication: Puka massive volume if healthy; elite WR1.

items.text: The more I watch Jaylen Warren, the more I love his game. The Steelers have something special.
items.why: Film/watching game; positive on talent and Steelers RB situation.
items.implication: Start with confidence; RB2/flex upside in favorable spots.
items.opportunity: Strong receiving/workhorse potential in PIT offense.

items.text: Berry hates Rome Odunze vs NE in Week 7 Love/Hate (WR32).
items.implication: Sit if better options; lower confidence start.

items.text: Berry loves DeVonta Smith vs DAL in Week 7 pass-catcher Love/Hate.
items.why: Usage/matchup in Berry list; PHI pass catchers theme.

items.text: Berry loves Tucker Kraft @ DET (TE6) in Love/Hate; Lions defense gift to opposing pass catchers.
items.opportunity: Targets vs soft Lions pass D.

items.text: In 10 Facts: Mike Washington season-high 33% snaps Week 6, one fewer rush than Ashton Jeanty. Jeanty under 3 YPC in 4/5 recent, lowest snap rates last 2. Possible bigger Washington role if Jeanty inefficient/not healthy.
items.why: Snap/rush/YPC data showing committee lean and inefficiency.
items.implication: Jeanty flex risk; monitor Washington handcuff/upside.
items.opportunity: Washington path to more carries if trend continues.
